clue.text: Incomprehensible speech from wife after large drink

indicators.note: after means the wife piece comes second, following the drink

parts.note: a double is a twice-sized measure of spirits
'my old Dutch' is Cockney slang for one's wife

explanation.surface: Someone talks gibberish after their wife has served them a big drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dutch' for wife comes from Cockney 'Duchess of Fife', rhyming slang for wife; 'after' simply places it second.
explanation.definitionFit: Double Dutch is an idiom for language nobody can follow, gibberish.

clue.text: Pickpocket's baptism

definitions.meaning: slang for a thief who picks pockets
an immersion, as in baptism by dipping in water

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are established: slang for a pickpocket, and the dipping of baptism by immersion.

clue.text: Muslim council implicated in misrule, maybe

indicators.note: implicated means folded into, so the answer lies inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A religious council is suspected of being involved in some misgovernment.
explanation.definitionFit: The ulema are the body of Muslim scholars who rule on religious law, a learned council.

clue.text: Stand for a lesson

parts.note: reads as tolerating a telling-off, but means the church stand from which the Bible lesson is read

explanation.definitionFit: A lectern is a reading desk in church where the scripture lesson is read aloud.

clue.text: Put on uniform and came into line in court

parts.note: soldiers dress ranks when they align themselves on parade
someone up before the magistrate is in court

explanation.surface: A soldier got into uniform, formed up in line and appeared before the judge.
explanation.definitionFit: To get dressed up is to put on special clothes such as a uniform or costume.

clue.text: Utter full amount

definitions.meaning: utter as an adjective, complete or absolute
the sum of everything, the grand figure

explanation.definitionFit: Total as adjective means complete or utter, and as noun means the whole sum.

clue.text: Hung about with concealed weapon

indicators.note: concealed means one piece is hidden inside another
about signals that the letters of hung are moved around

parts.note: and means together with, so with can stand for and

explanation.surface: A man hung about the place carrying a hidden gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hung about' looks like loitering, but 'about' is the anagram signal; 'with' is a synonym piece, not a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A handgun is a pistol, a small firearm held in one hand: a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Commercials getting the axe, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word is taken by its sound when spoken

parts.note: an adze is a cutting tool like an axe

explanation.surface: Advertisements are being cut, according to rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting the axe' looks like being cancelled, but 'the axe' is a tool whose name, an ADZE, sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ads is the short form for advertisements, the commercials shown on television.

clue.text: Mortal in charge in football club

indicators.note: the second in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: Arsenal is a London football club
IC is the standard short form used for someone in command

explanation.surface: Someone deadly is in charge at a football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Arsenical means containing arsenic, the poison, so deadly or fatal.

clue.text: Totally unhelpful way to shop?

parts.note: seems to describe rude staff, but means a store where customers help themselves since no assistant serves them

explanation.definitionFit: In a self-service shop no assistant helps you; you pick goods off the shelves yourself.

clue.text: Having foreknowledge, sent price reeling

indicators.note: reeling means spinning about, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who saw it coming sent the price spinning.
explanation.definitionFit: Prescient is a synonym meaning knowing about events before they happen.

clue.text: Point to a little girl with adenoids

parts.note: N is the north point of the compass
Sal is a short form of the name Sally or Sarah

explanation.surface: A gesture towards a small girl who has swollen adenoids.
explanation.definitionFit: Enlarged adenoids make a voice sound through the nose, so nasal describes such a speaker.

clue.text: The Navy's firmest supporters

parts.note: seems to mean loyal fans of the fleet, but means the steady limbs sailors develop on a rolling deck

explanation.definitionFit: Sea legs are the ability to stay balanced on a moving ship, a sailor's supporting legs.

clue.text: Drink in second team club

parts.note: a crew is a team, as of rowers
a driver is a golf club for long shots

explanation.surface: A second-string side has a drink in the clubhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A screwdriver is a cocktail of vodka and orange juice.

clue.text: The saintly lives of members about to die

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the limbs go round the other piece

parts.note: legs are limbs, members of the body
to end is to die

explanation.surface: Biographies of saints are given by members of a club who are about to die.
explanation.definitionFit: Legends were originally written lives of saints, read on their feast days.

clue.text: Hooded version of this bird hid in the forest

definitions.text: Hooded version of this bird hid in the forest

parts.words: Hooded version of this bird hid in the forest
parts.note: a garden bird with Hood after its name gives the outlaw of Sherwood Forest

explanation.definitionFit: Add 'Hood' to this red-breasted bird's name and you get the famous outlaw who hid in Sherwood Forest.

clue.text: Hoarding provisions — put on a charge

indicators.note: put on means placed on top of, setting one piece above the other in this down clue

parts.note: a bill is the charge you are asked to pay
board means meals provided, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: Someone stockpiling food has it all charged to their account.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hoarding' looks like storing up provisions, but it is a noun: a big advertising board.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoarding is the British word for a large outdoor advertising board.

clue.text: Where they're always putting up the rail fare

definitions.text: Where they're always putting up the rail fare

parts.words: Where they're always putting up the rail fare
parts.note: seems to be about ticket prices rising, but means the train carriage where food is served

explanation.definitionFit: A dining car is a railway carriage where meals, the fare of the rail journey, are served.

clue.text: Arrives in race — that's telling

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a nation is a people or race
ARR is the timetable abbreviation for arrives

explanation.surface: Someone arrives in the middle of a race, and the commentator explains it.
explanation.definitionFit: Narration is the act of telling a story, recounting events.

clue.text: It is pasted up with every exam

parts.note: every can mean all of them
an exam is a paper

explanation.surface: Every exam paper is pasted up on the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Wallpaper is the decorative paper pasted onto room walls.

clue.text: Lancer to opt for an entrance that'll be heard

indicators.note: that'll be heard means the phrase is taken by how it sounds when spoken

parts.note: to opt for an entrance is to pick a door

explanation.surface: A soldier wants to choose a noisy doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A picador is the horseman in a bullfight who goads the bull with a lance.

clue.text: Asian food knocked back in Information Technology room

indicators.note: knocked back means turned the other way, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: a lab is a room for experiments

explanation.surface: A curry is eaten quickly in the computer room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked back' looks like eating quickly but turns IT + LAB into BAL TI.
explanation.definitionFit: A balti is a South Asian style of curry cooked in a metal pan.

clue.text: Polish vase encircled by bloomer

indicators.note: encircled by means one piece is put inside another

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder, a bloomer
an urn is a kind of vase

explanation.surface: A Polish vase is surrounded by flowers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Polish' looks like the nationality but is the verb; 'bloomer' looks like a flower but is a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To burnish is to polish metal until it shines.

clue.text: Point of no return for rugger idol grabbing ball at outset

indicators.note: grabbing means holding another piece within

parts.note: RU is the abbreviation for Rugby Union, or rugger
an icon is an idol, an object of worship

indicators.note: at outset picks the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A rugby star snatches the ball at kick-off and there is no going back.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rubicon, the river Caesar crossed, stands as an idiom for a point of no return.

clue.text: Diana concocting watery spirit

indicators.note: concocting means making up, so the name is rearranged

explanation.surface: Diana is cooking up a water sprite.
explanation.definitionFit: A naiad is a water nymph of Greek myth, a spirit of rivers and springs.

clue.text: One holds on to a good quantity of land

indicators.note: holds means contains another piece

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
re means concerning, on a subject

explanation.surface: Someone holds onto a decent amount of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One' is a card: the ace counts as one. 'holds on to' reads as a single verb, but 'to' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Acreage is an area of land measured in acres.

clue.text: Vamp has to make up

definitions.meaning: to vamp is to improvise, as a musician does
to make up is to invent on the spot

explanation.definitionFit: Ad lib means improvise, which is what vamping and making up both mean.

clue.text: Food supplied by way of New Delhi at first

parts.note: via means by way of

indicators.note: at first picks the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: Food is shipped via New Delhi.
explanation.definitionFit: Viand is an old word for an item of food.

clue.text: I can back one friend from the start

indicators.note: back means the word is read the other way round

parts.note: a tin is a can
I is the Roman numeral one
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: I can support one friend from the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Initially means at the beginning or from the start.

clue.text: Even the old start to tipple

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of the

indicators.note: start to picks the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Even old folk start to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Yet and even are synonyms, as in 'yet more' and 'even more'.

clue.text: It may be used to find a perch

definitions.text: It may be used to find a perch

parts.words: It may be used to find a perch
parts.note: suggests a bird's resting place, but means catching a fish with tackle, and also a unit of length equal to a perch

explanation.definitionFit: A fishing pole catches perch; also an old unit of length equal to the perch.

clue.text: In which to get 4?

parts.note: the outfit one puts on to get suitably attired for horse-back exercise

explanation.walkthrough: The cross-reference is 4 down, dressed up: this is what an equestrian dresses up in.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the costume worn for horse-back exercise, so donning one means getting suitably attired.
